title: Projekt ASI
summary: A Kedro/FastAPI/Streamlit pipeline project that stores exoplanet data in PostgreSQL and offers endpoints to run the pipeline, generate synthetic data, and make predictions with Autogluon. It imports SDV's SingleTablePreset and SingleTableMetadata to generate synthetic tabular data for the exoplanets dataset.
